# hostaria_game_server (Resource)

Serveur de jeu (`/v1/game-servers`, game = ark | satisfactory).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hostaria_offer" "starter" {
  name = "Starter"
}

resource "hostaria_game_server" "ark" {
  game     = "ark"
  name     = "my-ark-server"
  offer_id = data.hostaria_offer.starter.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `game` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `offer_id` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `status` (String)
